test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Newton discovered the _______ of gravity while watching an apple fall from the tree.
solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is **'principle.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Principle** means **a rule for good behaviour, based on what a person believes is right.**

**​ -Example: **He was a man of **principle** and good to his word.

 
• So it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'Principle'.**
 
• The complete sentence is** "Newton discovered the principle of gravity while watching an apple fall from the tree".**

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Belief **means a feeling that somebody/something is true, morally good or right, or that somebody/something really exists.
 
• **Thesis** means a long piece of writing on a particular subject that you do as part of a university degree.
 
• **Code** means a system of words, letters, numbers, etc. that are used instead of the real letters or words to make a message or information secret.
